program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    words = 'ارتفعت المبيعات في شهر مارس'
    nums = 'نمو ٢٥٪ في عام ٢٠٢٤'
    img = render_ar_lines(wd / 'lines.png', [words, nums])
    raw = tesseract(img)
    text = ''.join((ch for ch in raw if ch not in _BIDI))
    lines = [l.strip() for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    marks = sum((raw.count(c) for c in _BIDI))
    src_nums = re.findall('\\d+', nums.translate(_AR_DIGITS))
    ocr_nums = re.findall('\\d+', ' '.join(lines[1:]).translate(_AR_DIGITS))
    report = {'ocr': lines, 'bidi_marks_removed': marks, 'numbers': [{'source': s, 'ocr': ocr_nums[i] if i < len(ocr_nums) else None, 'ok': i < len(ocr_nums) and ocr_nums[i] == s} for i, s in enumerate(src_nums)], 'rule': 'never trust OCR digits or %: verify every number against the image/source (ARL-15)'}
    out = write_json(wd, 'ocr-report.json', report)
    (wd / 'ocr.txt').write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
    blank = render_ar_lines(wd / 'blank.png', [''])
    neg = ''.join((ch for ch in tesseract(blank) if ch not in _BIDI)).strip()
    word_hits = sum((w in (lines[0] if lines else '') for w in words.split()))
    return ([check('Arabic words line read exactly', lines and lines[0] == words, lines[:1], words), check('every source word recovered', word_hits == 5, word_hits, 5), check('each source number gets its own verification row', len(report['numbers']) == 2 and [r['source'] for r in report['numbers']] == ['25', '2024'], [r['source'] for r in report['numbers']], ['25', '2024']), check('output has no bidi control marks left', not any((c in text for c in _BIDI))), check('negative control: a blank page yields no Arabic words', not re.search('[\u0600-ۿ]{2,}', neg), neg, '')], [out, img])
